Game Overview

Feathery Math is a math title where embark on a quirky quest with Archimedes as you reclaim his missing digits from cheeky chickens. Armed with a trusty rifle, aim and retrieve the right numbers in this delightful blend of precision and math. Unravel puzzles with careful shots amidst a backyard bustling with mischief.
